Aria (platform): Proposal: a minimal on-prem rotation flow for air-gapped customers that keeps downtime <30s for component swaps. Key idea: stage all artifacts, then perform an atomic activation pointer flip. Calling it "atomic-activation" for now. Thoughts?

Ken (infra): Sounds good. Must guarantee ABI compatibility during overlap. Suggest we embed a tiny compatibility manifest per snapshot and run a preflight graph check.

Rosa (ops): Operational constraints: some sites have <20GB spare disk so full staging might be impossible for large model blobs. Options: stream-activate or use a removable staging device. Need to document both.

Mika (eng-runtime): Implementation note: never overwrite runtime libs in-place on GPU nodes. Stage into `/opt/.staged/<comp>` and switch a symlink atomically. Ensure loader can accept dual-paths for a short grace period.

Leo (sre): Canary pattern: 2-node canary, 3m observation, then rack-level roll. Also take a filesystem snapshot pre-swap to enable deterministic rollback. Operator should hold a `symlink.snap` with exact pointers.

Aria (platform): Minimal activation manifest example we can standardize: {"component":"loader","rev":"v2.0.1","sha256":"d3f4...","abi":"glibc2.35","signed":"true"} — verifier runs before activation.

deploy-bot: sandbox run scheduled for 2024-09-05T20:00Z :calendar: (ops notified)

Rosa (ops): Rollback SLA: restore pointer+restart in <10m. Also need metrics capture: staging_time, activate_latency, rollback_time, peak_disk. Will run dry-run in lab.

Mika (eng-runtime): For air-gapped installs, signature verification must be built into the operator and mandatory for activation. Add leader-election so operator is single source-of-truth for activation state.

Ken (infra): GC policy: unreferenced staged artifacts TTL default 48h, admin override. Add `prune --dry-run` to operator CLI.

Aria (platform): I'll draft an RFC with sequence diagrams and a k8s operator contract (stage/verify/activate/rollback). Please volunteer to review: @Mika @Leo?

Mika (eng-runtime): Happy to review operator contract.

Leo (sre): I'll check dry-run metrics and suggest safe canary windows.

Aria (platform): Great. I'll post RFC link once ready. Thanks.
